messages:
Samira Khan: Hey! first day hardware arrived (MacBook Air M1). Setup assistant completed but when I tried to install Homebrew it complains about 'Rosetta not found' and then the macOS update prompt says 'Upgrade to Ventura blocked by MDM'. Also I don't have sudo to install a bunch of CLI tools. Any recommended steps?
Liam O'Connor (IT): welcome Samira! M1 machines need Rosetta for some x86 brew bottles. we usually let new hires install Rosetta; ping me and I can grant a short-lived admin token. Ventura upgrade is blocked until we validate images. what serial do you have?
Samira Khan: serial C02TQ8BB5L8H.
onboarding-bot: Welcome Samira! Please complete the Quickstart checklist in #new-hires/onboarding.
it-ops-bot: Policy: Major OS upgrades are blocked for managed devices. To request exception open ticket: "OS upgrade exception for <serial>". For temporary admin: "Temporary admin for <serial> for onboarding".
Liam O'Connor (IT): I see the device in DEP as enrolled. We can enable sudo for 48h. I'll need a ticket to track the elevation. If you want to install Rosetta manually run: /usr/sbin/softwareupdate --install-rosetta --agree-to-license (requires admin).
Samira Khan: opened ticket IT-2103: "Temporary admin for C02TQ8BB5L8H for installing dev tooling and Rosetta".
Liam O'Connor (IT): approved. admin elevation applied for 48h. you should see sudo after a logout/login. note: MDM will still block the Ventura upgrade until imaging team signs off. if you need a specific package that requires Ventura, tell me and we can evaluate.
Samira Khan: thanks! sudo now works after logout. running the Rosetta command.
Priyanka Rao: hey Samira 1ook out for a few CI tools that may need x86 emulation. LMK if you hit anything odd and i'll share my dotfiles.
Samira Khan: Rosetta installed successfully. brew install git worked. Docker Desktop ran but asked for a privileged helper install which failed at first; reran with sudo and it succeeded. FileVault started encrypting and shows 1% (just started).
Liam O'Connor (IT): good. reminder: keep the laptop plugged in while FileVault completes. we'll automatically escrow the recovery key to our KMS. I'll monitor IT-2103 and revoke admin after 48h.
Samira Khan: appreciate it. any ETA on when Ventura will be allowed?
Liam O'Connor (IT): imaging team typically validates new macOS major releases within 2-3 weeks after release. if you have a business need we can escalate the exception request (use ticket IT-2103 to add context).
Samira Khan: perfect. thanks everyone, excited to be here! :partyparrot:
Priyanka Rao: welcome aboard Samira :wave:
